newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangdong Kelon loan raised to US$70 mln.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong Kelon loan raised to US$70 mln.

text.p: Guangdong Kelon Electrical Holdings Co Ltd, China's leading refrigerator maker, said it received a US$70 million loan from 14 banks to further expand its production facilities and distribution networks.
The three-year loan pays a margin of 100 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate, and was increased to US$70 million from US$50 million originally.
BA Asia is lead arranger and lead manager, and Sumitomo Bank's Guangzhou branch is arranger and lead manager.

Banque National de Paris's Shenzhen branch, Commerz (East Asia) Hong Kong branch, Dresdner Bank's Shenzhen branch, Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan's Hong Kong branch and United Overseas bank's Guangdong branch are co-arrangers and co-lead managers.

Banco Central Hispanoamericano's Hong Kong branch, Bank Austria's Hong Kong branch, BHF Bank's Hong Kong branch, Korea Development Bank's Shanghai branch, Kredietbank's Shanghai branch and Tokai Bank are senior managers.
Sanwa Bank's Shenzhen branch is manager.
